findings.ref: requirements.md AC-047; resolve-project-context.py:_recover_journal and main PublicationJournalRecoveryError handler
findings.note: An unrecoverable journal is required to leave live state exactly as found, but the handler subsequently publishes Resolver Evidence through a new transaction. Resolver Evidence is itself one of the original transaction's live targets, so an absent or pre-existing evidence target is changed after recovery refuses the journal. The recovery test asserts exact preservation for other targets while explicitly expecting this mutation.

PublicationStagingAreaUncontained Blocks through the no-write path and produces no Resolver Evidence. AC-012 requires evidence for every Block except its stated exceptions, and the bundle provides no approved exception or frozen amendment for compromised staging; the test only labels this a disclosed interaction. Consequently the implementation and its tests encode behavior outside the governing requirement.
